description: Open a developer account for the user (needs their qumge key). There is no review and no waiting: it takes effect immediately, and publish_app works right after. Give a display name and an ISO country code; the country decides tax and payout rails later. Payout details and legal name are only needed when the user actually withdraws money.

country.description: ISO code like "US" or "CN" (a full country name also works).

display_name.description: The name shown on their app pages.

qumge_key.description: Optional: your Qumge API key, for clients that cannot set an Authorization header. Takes precedence over the header. Never echoed back.

social_links.description: Up to 6 public URLs (X, GitHub, LinkedIn, their website). The kind is guessed from the domain.

name: become_developer
